content.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
content.summary: Shares of global pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) jumped 3.3% in the morning session after the company announced a partnership to develop a new oral obesity drug and was reported to be in advanced talks to acquire Ventyx Biosciences for over $1 billion.

content.title: Eli Lilly Nears Deal for Biotech Ventyx
content.summary: Eli Lilly  is in advanced talks to acquire  Ventyx Biosciences  for around $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.  A deal for Ventyx, which specializes in developing pills that can treat inflammatory diseases, could come as soon as Wednesday, the people said.  Ventyx, of San Diego, had a market value of a little over $500 million as of Tuesday afternoon.
